text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Since independence in 1962 from French colonial rule, the sons of Algeria have foiled through hard work and patriotism colonialist allegations that Algerians were unfitted to build a modern state.
- Algeria celebrates the 35th anniversary of its independence as the country is preparing for local elections to complete a multiparty election process that started in 1995 by a presidential poll.
